question: What is the meaning of logistics information in relation to supply chain traceability, suppliers’ information, logistics?
data_group: supply chain traceability, suppliers’ information, logistics
description: Logistics information in relation to supply chain traceability involves tracking and managing the movement of goods and materials from suppliers to the final product, ensuring transparency and accountability throughout the supply chain. This information helps brands and OEMs monitor their supply chains, comply with sustainability regulations, and implement circular economy practices. Suppliers' information, on the other hand, refers to the detailed data provided by suppliers, including bill of materials and environmental data, which is essential for maintaining traceability and circularity in the supply chain. Logistics encompasses the entire process of transporting, storing, and handling goods and materials, ensuring efficient and secure exchange of product circularity information along the value chain.

3.2.1. Product Circularity Data Sheet (PCDS)
In order to address barriers and opportunities identiﬁed during the consultation
process, the PCDS was co-created between the Ministry of the Economy, PositiveIm-
paKT, and more than 50 manufacturers, data aggregation platforms and standards bodies.
According to the report to the Ministry,
“To enable efﬁcient and secure exchange of product circularity information along
the value chain, standardization of the data and format is needed, including an
auditing process” [54].
